title: One AI model now controls this robot's entire body
caption:
Unitree's UnifoLM-OminiA-0.3 is a single model that drives whole-body mobile manipulation — no separate systems for perception, movement and interaction.

In this demo it handles a range of home-care and wellness tasks fully autonomously, understanding voice, vision and touch in real time while staying stable even when pushed or disturbed.

It's a glimpse of where general-purpose home robots are heading: one model, many tasks.
